summary: We are doubling down on China-based programs—Asia Star and Intelligent China—as our top search/AI visibility priorities, while finalizing the Knowledge website redesign and resolving a lingering email lockout that has stalled team access.
summaryDetail: The big bet right now is making Asia Star and Intelligent China the flagships of our global marketing push, with US partner programs (Stanford, Columbia, Berkeley) relegated to secondary status for the first quarter. This week, the immediate fire is the Outlook account lockout—everyone must delete and re-login on all devices and confirm the backend unlock with CKGSB IT so we stop losing time. On the Knowledge website, we've chosen to keep the current layout with menu tweaks and Joseph's editorial inspiration; Joseph needs to share his HTML file and the team must hold a 30-minute feedback session before Joker makes design changes. Looking ahead, Joseph is drafting the search prompts we want to own, the team is analyzing Asia Star participant profiles, and we need the conversion tracking brief to set up measurement. Meanwhile, several content items are queued for review—the YouTube edit plan, Manaferra brand prompts, and the Western MBA press release—but the homepage launch is the gate for sending Zongchao the updated PPT and URLs.
